gateways.form.issuerHintEdit: The OAuth Authorization Server issuer URL. Required for DCR.
gateways.form.resourceHintAdmin: RFC 8707 resource indicator sent to the IdP. When admins leave this blank, the gateway derives it from the gateway URL origin, and each user's actual token audience is auto-learned per-user on their own OAuth callback. Set explicitly here to force a global (all-user) audience — for example, when you need a specific Application ID URI in multi-tenant Entra ID. To make a stored value take effect again, users simply re-authenticate; to clear this admin-configured value, blank the field and save.

gateways.form.issuerHint: The OAuth Authorization Server issuer URL. Required for DCR (Dynamic Client Registration).
gateways.form.resourceHint: RFC 8707 resource indicator sent to the IdP and used as the expected token audience. Leave blank to auto-derive from the gateway URL origin and auto-learn from the IdP's first token response. Set explicitly for IdPs (ServiceNow, Authentik) that use a client_id or other opaque audience identifier.
